texts.zh: 我们同[fruitful_coop_country.GetName]签署的贸易协定带来了累累硕果。双方都遵守协定条款，贸易正在流通。一些商人呼吁在规章制度方面进一步放宽，但总体来说协定给双方都带来了益处。
texts.en: The trade deal we signed with the [fruitful_coop_country.GetName] has proven extremely lucrative. The terms of the deal are being respected and trade is flowing. Some merchants continue to call for more relaxed regulation, but overall the deal has proven beneficial for both parties.
